messages:
sam: Heads-up — I hit a weird mypy/pyright error with the async client + autogenerated models in the sampleapp. Repro below.

sam: Minimal repro: client.jobs.list_jobs(...) is typed as AsyncIterator[Optional[CreateJobResponse]] so mypy complains when I do `async for j in ...: print(j.job_id)` — it thinks j could be None.

sam: Snippet:
```py
class JobsClient:
    async def list_jobs(self, *, page_size: int = 100) -> AsyncIterator[Optional[CreateJobResponse]]: ...

async for job in client.jobs.list_jobs(page_size=50):
    print(job.job_id)  # mypy: Optional has no attribute job_id
```

yara: Is the Optional coming from items being nullable or the array/container marked nullable?

sam: The OpenAPI has items: {"$ref":"#/components/schemas/CreateJobResponse"} but the response array has nullable: true on the array itself. autogen incorrectly applies container nullability to the item type.

alex: Confirmed. Codegen currently does: if container_nullable: item_type = Optional[item_type]. That makes sense for sync responses where the whole list can be null, but for paginated iterators we should model the iterator as empty instead of yielding None.

mikey: Workarounds: `if job is None: continue` or `assert job is not None`, or cast, but they’re ugly.

sam: Proposed fix: change generator typing to AsyncIterator[CreateJobResponse] when items are non-nullable, even if container is nullable. Add unit tests covering nullable array vs nullable items.

alex: I'll open a PR (labels: devex, codegen, typing). Will add a migration note: clients generated before the fix may have Optional in signatures; recommend pinning sdk >= X.Y.Z.

ci-bot: CI started for branch fix/codegen-iterator-nullable-1768 — 1 job queued. :gear:

yara: Also propose adding a lightweight mypy check to the sampleapp CI so regressions trigger quickly. Keep it scoped to public surfaces/examples to stay fast.

alex: Good idea — will add a mypy job in devex/sampleapp workflow and pin types versions.

mikey: Ping me on the PR for a review, I’ll scan for other places we applied container-nullability to item types.

sam: Filing tracking ticket GH #4821 and linking in the PR. Thanks everyone.
